title: ctx-sys status --json
description: Output shape of `ctx-sys status --json`. v2 F1.4: stable contract yaao and other consumers parse against. SemVer-locked to the package version; breaking changes only on major releases.

path.description: Absolute path of the project root the status was computed for.

name.description: Project name from .ctx-sys/config.yaml, or the basename of the path if uninitialized.

initialized.description: True if a project-local config.yaml exists.

project.description: True if a project-local config.yaml exists.

database.description: Resolved database path the engine will use.

exists.description: True if the database file is present on disk.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the database file in bytes (0 when not present).

checks.description: Present only when `--check` was passed. Each entry is a health-check result.

recommendations.description: Present only when `--check` was passed. Recovery hints aggregated from failing checks.
